name: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives (Instant NGP)
definition: An improved NeRF implementation that significantly shortens training and rendering time (to within a minute) and enables real-time rendering. It replaces most parameters in the original NeRF network with a smaller network and uses Multi-resolution Hash Encoding.
summary: Instant NGP is a high-performance neural radiance field method that achieves real-time rendering and fast convergence by replacing deep MLPs with multi-resolution hash grids and optimized CUDA kernels.
